geographic_coverage.global_layer: occupation identity, generic purpose, typical tasks, transferable and technical skills, knowledge domains, work contexts and specializations
geographic_coverage.localization_layer: country-specific education routes, qualifications, protected titles, licences, legal requirements, salary ranges, demand and employment outlook
geographic_coverage.country_fact_rule: Every country-specific fact must carry an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, a directly relevant source, source date or checked_at date, and a review/expiry policy.

salary_estimation_policy.verified: Use occupation-level national statistics or official pay scales with source, period, currency and gross/net definition.
salary_estimation_policy.modeled: A provisional scenario estimate may be displayed as a non-factual planning aid. This is not treated as a national fact or an official wage observation; label it modeled, low confidence and USD-equivalent.
salary_estimation_policy.currency: Do not imply USD-equivalent amounts are local-currency quotations; convert only with a dated, documented FX source.
salary_estimation_policy.no_fabrication: Never label modeled values as verified or use a national average as if it were an occupation-specific observation.

content_rules.language_strategy: French and English source labels are retained where available; localization to other languages is a later content workstream.
content_rules.reading_levels: Use plain-language summaries first, with expandable technical detail.
content_rules.career_stage: Never infer suitability solely from age, degree, country or previous job title.
content_rules.recommendations: Explain evidence, assumptions, uncertainty and skill gaps; do not present match scores as guarantees.
content_rules.publication: Explorer content may be integrated with evidence tiers visible; do not certify national salary, qualification, legal or labour-demand facts without country-specific authority/source. Modeled salary scenarios are not official statistics.
